rationale: Pedro is building AI agent tooling infrastructure at ITA Robio, while Pranav leads AI solutions at Appsmith, a developer-tools platform — creating a natural opportunity to explore how better tooling can support agent-first applications. Both work in TypeScript and share focus on the AI and developer-tools domains, with complementary expertise in infrastructure (Pedro) and platform solutions (Pranav) that could unlock new use cases.
intro_message: Pedro Nagamine de Lima, meet Pranav Kanade — you're both building at the intersection of AI and developer tooling, and Pranav's work on AI solutions at Appsmith could directly inform the infrastructure challenges Pedro is tackling with agent marketplaces and tooling at ITA Robio.
